slides.title: On TikTok, a single comment can now be a post.
Repost one comment.
slides.body: Users can repost a single comment without sharing the original video.

slides.title: Replies travel on their own.
slides.body: They can be discovered outside the thread where they first appeared.

slides.title: Community management is a growth lever.
slides.body: A sharp reply, a witty player reaction or a great fan comment can reach people who never saw the clip.

slides.title: Ask questions, predictions or debates in captions, then amplify the best fan answers.
Have fast, on-brand responders ready for matches and key moments.
Keep moderation tight.
slides.body: A careless reply can now spread beyond its thread.
